svg.title: The final project, from above
svg.desc: An animation, seen from above, of the Module 2 final project. A taped circle has a straight strip of tape across its middle, crossing the circle at two points, the crosses, one on the left and one on the right. The robot starts at the bottom of the circle and follows it to the right-hand cross. Its sensors reach the cross first and it stops; it drives forward to park its wheels on the cross, then makes two clockwise turns, first onto the strip and then onto the circle going the other way. It follows the bottom of the circle back to the left-hand cross and reverses there the same way, then back to the right, then back to the left: four reversals, and it stops. A panel beside it names each stage: following to the cross, cross detected and reversing, and done.
svg.text: 1. Follow the circle to the cross
2. Park on it and turn around
